definition: Declared weighted mean of physical error ratios versus v55. Lower is better on these criteria; not perceived similarity or proof of exact match. No reference-derived audio in candidates. Ranking cannot establish a unique perceptual best.
sensitivity: 10000 deterministic Dirichlet(weight*100) draws; no subjective audition
